description:
At OneStream, we're on a mission to empower every Finance organization and professional to exceed their potential. Our global teams span continents, cultures, and time zones, united by a shared purpose as we build the operating system for modern Finance and help organizations move with greater speed, clarity, and confidence.

 That mission comes to life through our people. Behind every innovation, customer success, and milestone are talented people working together to make a difference. That's  why  we're  looking for people who are  bold enough to think big, authentic in how they lead and collaborate, curious about  what's  possible, and committed to delivering results. 

 Want a closer look before you apply? Explore our Careers site to learn more about our people, culture, and benefits.

 Summary   

 The AI eLearning Developer contributes to the AI training & enablement programs that guide our customer & implementation ecosystems. Reporting to the Director, AI Enablement and Operations, this role co- creates digital learning materials and experiences that help learners build skills and capabilities with our products, alongside our AI product & delivery teams. Applying learning standards & frameworks to maintain a professional grade training offering.  This role also supports the smooth operation of AI training delivery, including keeping the course catalog current.    

 Primary Duties and Responsibilities   

 eLearning Content Development    

 
 Create digital learning materials and experiences that help learners build skills and capabilities with our products, including interactive eLearning content, simulations, labs, and knowledge checks.    

 
 
 Support creation of scaffolded learning pathways that build skills progressively, for persona specific audiences, alongside AI Product & Delivery teams.    

 
 
 Use AI powered tools & learning platform features to author highly engaging courses and workshops quickly and efficiently.    

 
 
 Develop & maintain working expertise of the OneStream SensibleAI products as they evolve.    

 
 Instructional Design & Quality    

 
 Apply and guide others on adult learning principles and instructional design models.    

 
 
 Apply training standards and frameworks, and the QA rubric to ensure a professional grade quality training offering.    

 
 
 Support internal AI & Ops learning efforts, alongside the Dir, AI Enablement.    

 
 Learning Platform Operations & Enablement Analytics    

 
 Author  courses on the learning platform and become a platform subject matter expert.    

 
 
 Maintain existing courses current & relevant, based on team assigned schedule including updating existing courses, labs and learning materials.    

 
 
 Support reporting & impact reporting initiatives.       

 
 Required Education and Experience   

 
 2-4 years of experience in eLearning development, instructional design or training content creation, preferably for enterprise software or other technical or semi-technical audiences.    

 
 
 Experience building interactive eLearning content (written and/or multimedia), such as simulations, labs and knowledge checks.    

 
 
 Working knowledge of adult learning principles and instructional design models.    

 
 
 Comfort working with LMS platforms (authoring, publishing).    

 
 
 Bachelor’s degree in Education, Communications, Business, Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience.    

 
 Preferred Education and Experience   

 
 Claude skill development    

 
 
 Experience with eLearning authoring & simulation tools (such as Articulate Rise, Storyline or Skillable Labs)    

 
 
 Experience in enterprise software, data-driven platforms, or software project implementation    

 
 Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities   

 
 Customer persona knowledge: end user, admin and power user needs    

 
 
 Self motivated to learn new systems, and AI-powered enablement strategies    

 
 
 Customer/partner-first mindset    

 
 
 Strong organization and attention to detail    

 
 Supervisory Responsibilities   

 
 None    

 
 Travel   

 Travel Requirement: Some travel is expected for this role and a willingness to travel up to 10% of work time will be required.   

   

 Physical, Visual, and Mental Demands   

 While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to hear and speak effectively, reach with hands and arms, make repetitive movement of hands and fingers such as typing and/or writing. The position is mostly sedentary, involving sitting and/or standing, but the employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 to 25 pounds. The employee must be able to understand, remember, and apply oral and/or written instructions or other information, apply common sense in performing job, and can organize and prioritize responsibilities. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.   

   

 Other Duties   

 Employees are required to adhere to OneStream’s Corporate, Departmental & Information Security policies. This includes compliance with all policies, such as Acceptable Use and Privacy policies, and the completion of required annual training in a timely manner. Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.    

   

 Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities   

   

 Benefits at OneStream    
OneStream employees are passionate, hardworking individuals who go above and beyond to keep our customers happy and follow through on our mission statement. They consistently deliver the best and in turn, we make every effort to keep them cared for and happy. A sample of the benefits we provide are:

 
 Excellent Medical Plan

 Dental & Vision Insurance

 Life Insurance

 Short & Long Term Disability

 Vacation Time

 Paid Holidays

 Professional Development

 Retirement Plan

 Total compensation is based on experience, skills, and location using objective, job-related criteria. Additional variable compensation and benefits may apply. 

 Gross annual base salary
 $65,000 — $84,500 USD 


  

 All candidates must be legally authorized to work for any company in the country where this position is located without sponsorship. 

   
OneStream Software is an equal opportunity employer.   All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations, and ordinances. 

 If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, reach out to   RecruitingAccommodations@onestreamsoftware.com .  

 OneStream may use the personal information you provide to process your application and contact you, in accordance with applicable privacy laws such as the CCPA and GDPR. For more information about how we handle your personal information, please review  OneStream's Privacy Policy . 

 Emails about job opportunities at OneStream are only sent by employees with an @onestreamsoftware.com email address. Reach out to your contact at OneStream  if you suspect a phishing scam.
